description: Test scenarios to verify AI tool selection with different description versions

testScenarios.userRequest: Fetch this page https://eng.ms/docs/architecture-guidance
testScenarios.expectedReason: Corporate/enterprise domain requiring authentication

testScenarios.userRequest: Get the content from https://microsoft.sharepoint.com/teams/myteam
testScenarios.expectedReason: Microsoft internal site with SSO

testScenarios.userRequest: Navigate to https://portal.azure.com and summarize the dashboard
testScenarios.expectedReason: Azure domain requiring auth and JavaScript

testScenarios.userRequest: Fetch https://example.com/react-app
testScenarios.expectedReason: JavaScript-heavy SPA (mentioned React)

testScenarios.userRequest: Get the page https://randomcompany.internal/docs
testScenarios.expectedReason: *.internal domain pattern

testScenarios.userRequest: Go to https://example.com/login and fill in username field with 'test@example.com'
testScenarios.expectedReason: Must fetch page first, then type into form

testScenarios.userRequest: On the already loaded inbox page, run a JavaScript snippet to return the first 5 rows with sender and subject.
testScenarios.expectedReason: Page-scoped JavaScript extraction on already loaded page

testScenarios.userRequest: Load https://example.com and click the 'Next' button
testScenarios.expectedReason: Must fetch page first, then click for navigation

testScenarios.userRequest: Login to https://app.example.com with username 'user' and password 'pass', then click submit
testScenarios.expectedReason: Full login workflow: fetch, fill username, fill password, click submit

testScenarios.userRequest: If a click on an element times out, retry with a JavaScript click and report whether fallback was used.
testScenarios.expectedReason: browser_click_element handles native timeout with automatic JS fallback and metadata

testScenarios.userRequest: After clicking that button, what does the page say now?
testScenarios.expectedReason: Checking current page state without reloading

testScenarios.userRequest: Fetch https://example.com/simple.html
testScenarios.expectedReason: When unsure, default to browser fetch (works for simple pages too)

testScenarios.userRequest: Call the API at https://api.example.com/users
testScenarios.expectedReason: API endpoints can use basic HTTP fetch

testScenarios.userRequest: Close the browser tab for https://example.com to clear the session
testScenarios.expectedReason: Explicitly asked to close tab

testScenarios.userRequest: Use the Gmail plugin to list my recent emails
testScenarios.expectedReason: User explicitly requests a plugin action for a specific site

testScenarios.userRequest: What plugins are available for this browser?
testScenarios.expectedReason: User asks about available plugins or plugin capabilities

testScenarios.userRequest: Show me what actions the Outlook plugin can do
testScenarios.expectedReason: User wants to discover plugin actions before using them

testScenarios.userRequest: Open this internal wiki page that requires login: https://wiki.company.com/docs
testScenarios.expectedReason: Page requires authentication — needs a real browser with login support

testScenarios.userRequest: Load this React dashboard and extract the data from the table
testScenarios.expectedReason: SPA page requires full JavaScript execution to render content

testScenarios.userRequest: Fetch the content from our SSO-protected SharePoint site
testScenarios.expectedReason: SSO-protected page needs real browser with login flow support

testScenarios.userRequest: This page keeps showing a Cloudflare challenge, can you load it?
testScenarios.expectedReason: Anti-bot protection requires real browser with JavaScript execution

testScenarios.userRequest: Check if my website at https://myapp.azurewebsites.net is working
testScenarios.expectedReason: Verifying a deployment URL by loading it in a real browser

testScenarios.userRequest: Check my Gmail inbox and summarize the top 3 emails
testScenarios.expectedReason: No dedicated email tool exists, but browser can access Gmail via user's logged-in session

testScenarios.userRequest: What meetings do I have today on Google Calendar?
testScenarios.expectedReason: Agent should navigate to calendar web app using the user's logged-in browser session

testScenarios.userRequest: Read my latest Jira tickets
testScenarios.expectedReason: Agent should infer Jira URL and use browser to access the authenticated web app

testScenarios.userRequest: Do I have any new emails in Outlook?
testScenarios.expectedReason: Browser can access Outlook web app with the user's existing session cookies

testScenarios.userRequest: Show me the status of my Azure resources
testScenarios.expectedReason: Agent should open Azure Portal dashboard using the authenticated browser session

testScenarios.userRequest: Check my GitHub notifications
testScenarios.expectedReason: Browser can access GitHub with the user's logged-in session to read notifications

evaluationCriteria.toolSelectionAccuracy: Percentage of scenarios where correct tool was chosen
evaluationCriteria.sequenceAccuracy: Percentage of multi-step scenarios with correct tool sequence
evaluationCriteria.mustNotUseViolations: Count of scenarios where forbidden tool was used
